decisions.reason: Localizes the fault to the workspace-files/client-resources provider read path via the same-file contrast probe and stuck meta.status 'none'; rules out disk, static serving, and tab claiming without demanding an unseen internal function.
Marks per-module/manifest-verbatim fetches valid and the ~4–5 KB joined 404 as a synthetic probe artifact, notes combo chunking/URL limits, and never claims missing modules.

Treats paste-input fold warnings as unrelated; uses the manifest excerpt to explain textpreview→documentpreview and the session-only canOpen scope, correctly splitting the absolute-address claim failure from the session tab's stalled read.

Restart once → rollback if still broken (pinned install, including the #5999-verified 0.1.3-alpha.2) → upstream; explicitly rejects plugin-side rewrite/retry/fallback and duplication, and treats alpha.1's roster bug as prior art.

Complete forensics list (versions, install channel, roster+rev, labeled probes, contrast probe, logs) and named host diagnostics including a resource-provider handshake and contract-version check at boot.

caps.reason: The joined 404 is explicitly labeled invalid and never used affirmatively as evidence of missing modules.
Plugin-side workarounds and duplicating the service are explicitly rejected as masking the host regression.
